distribution.narrative: 黄复生等 (2015) reports Sichuan and Yunnan for this taxon. The checklist assessment remains unreviewed, so the mainland-China occurrence is presented as Candidate rather than promoted to an accepted occurrence.
distribution.evidence: 黄复生等 (2015), published as Acanthotomicus perexignus; province-level distribution: 四川，云南.

host_note: 黄复生等 (2015) reports 西南桦 / Betula alnoides.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted backbone identity is Acanthotomicus perexiguus (Blandford, 1896). 黄复生等 (2015) uses the spelling Acanthotomicus perexignus.
